title: pilosocereus polygonus
intro: Pilosocereus polygonus, commonly known as the Dragon Fruit Cactus or Night-Blooming Cereus, is a species of cactus in the genus Pilosocereus. This plant is native to Mexico and the southwestern United States and is known for its vibrant flowers that bloom at night, emitting a strong, sweet fragrance. The health benefits of Pilosocereus polygonus include its potential to lower blood sugar levels and reduce inflammation, while its therapeutic actions may include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
